A bare `<` in a default-value expression (e.g. `a = x < y`) is treated as a generic opener; this can undercount, never overcount, and is rare in parameter defaults.
The regex capture `[^)]*` truncating at the first `)` (nested-paren defaults) and missing multi-line parameter lists is a separate root cause in the capture, not the count, and is left out of scope.
Lower parameterCount values shifting the arch baseline downward is an improvement; no baseline was updated.
